description: This file defines the 'Xf' class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, representing an Excel cell format record within the XLS writer. It handles the generation of BIFF XF (Extended Format) records for styling cells, including border, color, font, and alignment properties.

classes.name: Xf
classes.description: Represents an Excel XF (eXtended Format) record used for cell styling in the XLS writer component of PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: writeXf
methods.description: Generates an Excel BIFF XF record string, encoding style, border, color, font, and alignment properties into binary format.

methods.name: setIsStyleXf
methods.description: Sets whether this XF record is a style XF or a cell XF.

methods.name: setBottomColor
methods.description: Sets the color index for the bottom border of the cell.

methods.name: setTopColor
methods.description: Sets the color index for the top border of the cell.

methods.name: setLeftColor
methods.description: Sets the color index for the left border of the cell.

methods.name: setRightColor
methods.description: Sets the color index for the right border of the cell.

methods.name: setDiagColor
methods.description: Sets the color index for the diagonal border of the cell.

methods.name: setFgColor
methods.description: Sets the foreground color index for the cell.

methods.name: setBgColor
methods.description: Sets the background color index for the cell.

methods.name: setNumberFormatIndex
methods.description: Sets the index of the number format record associated with this XF.

methods.name: setFontIndex
methods.description: Sets the font index for this XF.

methods.name: mapTextRotation
methods.description: Maps a text rotation angle to the BIFF8 code used in the binary XF record.

methods.name: mapLocked
methods.description: Maps a protection 'locked' status to its corresponding BIFF value.

methods.name: mapHidden
methods.description: Maps a protection 'hidden' status to its corresponding BIFF value.
